role: Current-video visual inspection; reference comparison belongs to parent task

method.decode: CPU ffmpeg -hwaccel none; all 720 frames decoded and measured
method.dense_inspection: every frame around all text boundaries, plus 0.1s sheets around requested 2,6,11,14,15,19.5s windows
method.native_inspection: native-resolution crop of Suez marker at f180
method.storage: Only scripts, metrics, selected PNGs and contact sheets; no frame archive

text_style.observed: Uppercase thin sans-serif, pale gray/ivory fill, dark narrow outline and a large soft neutral/dark shadow surrounding the line
text_style.screen_size: Approximately 44–50 native pixels of visible capital height; SUEZ CANAL about 330 native pixels wide and SINGAPORE about 310 native pixels wide
text_style.entrance: Fill and outline become visible over about 12 frames; shadow appears strongly on first active frame. No confirmed positional or scale entrance and no letter-by-letter reveal
text_style.exit: Fill and outline fade over approximately 10 frames, leaving diffuse shadow strongest at the final active frame; all overlay disappears at its end boundary
text_style.camera_relationship: Line glyph size stays approximately constant on screen while globe/map scale changes. Positions move with camera/geographic framing; no separate text-slide animation detected
text_style.confidence: high for visible style and fade boundaries; approximate size and coordinates; easing formula cannot be established from pixels alone

positions_native_approximate.note: Label over Arabian/Red Sea region on static initial globe
Similar screen location after close zoom
At wide view the line keeps large screen size; positioned over Arabia
Above Suez line; both nearly left-aligned at wide view
Label falls southwest/below actual Southeast Asia city-light area; no leader visible
Close map view; no separate point icon visible

suez_closed_cross.appearance: Faint peach/orange geographic X: one nearly vertical arm and one diagonal arm, with a pale yellow central crossing
suez_closed_cross.motion: No confirmed scale change, expanding ring or cyclic pulse. Limb bbox is approximately unchanged at first and last active frame; shadow and codec changes contaminate neutral frame-difference intensity
suez_closed_cross.confidence: high for cross shape/on-off boundaries; no pulse detected

markers.suez_location_pin: No conventional pin, dot+leader, or radial pulse observed at the 2s label entrance
markers.suez_open_marker: No green marker or other visible geometric replacement when OPEN begins
markers.singapore_pin: No conventional pin, ring, leader or distinct overlay glow visible at 15s or close view at 19.5s; dense anchor crop examined to final frame

other_visible_effects.globe: Pure black background, narrow blue/cyan atmosphere limb, cloud texture, terminator shading and tiny city lights visible in Asia framing
other_visible_effects.suez_close: Large soft bluish-white round light patch on Mediterranean left of canal. Already visible before CLOSED; does not switch with the status cue
other_visible_effects.status_glows: No colored status glow, route/path highlight, map-region fill or scan effect detected
other_visible_effects.uncertainty: Very low-contrast subpixel effects cannot be ruled out. City-light flecks and Singapore brown/red shoreline colors appear part of the map imagery/rendering, not separable animated markers

content_and_outro.outro: No distinct outro/end-card/logo/subscribe overlay appears; map content remains to the last frame while Singapore label fades
